decisions.rationale: Most recent NOA ($67,280) supports the stated $67,500 and the letter shows $69,774; the degraded pay stub is not needed.
A $30,500 gift from a cousin is documented with a no-repayment letter, but policy limits gifts to close family and funds excluding the gift fall short.
Letter is dated 30 June 2026, about 75 days before review, so whether it is recent is unclear, though recent payroll deposits corroborate employment.
Worksheet GDS about 29-32% and TDS about 35-43% (even counting the paid-off loan) are within limits with score 715.
